publisher: Roane County, TN (layer published by ArcGIS Online user jwander2022)
notes: Unofficial copy: hosted on ArcGIS Online by user jwander2022, not a county-owned service; no official queryable Roane County zoning service was found (county app experience 3c4eaf58... is viewer-only). Multi-jurisdiction layer; JUR is jurisdiction (RURAL for unincorporated county land, city names otherwise). ZONING holds the district code; Zoning_TEMP is a placeholder and is not used. Non-district polygons (RAILROAD, ROW, WATER) are present. Service is slow with large page sizes; page_size 100 required.
